# Code Review Skill

## Review Checklist

### Code Quality
- Check naming conventions.
- Identify duplication.
- Check readability.
- Identify unnecessary complexity.

### Bugs
- Check null handling.
- Check boundary conditions.
- Check exception handling.
- Identify logic errors.

### Security
- Identify exposed secrets.
- Check unsafe input handling.
- Identify insecure patterns.

### Testing
- Identify missing test cases.
- Check assertions.
- Check negative scenarios.
- Check edge cases.

### Performance
- Identify inefficient operations.
- Check unnecessary loops.
- Identify avoidable processing.

## Review Format

For each finding:

- Issue
- Severity
- File
- Explanation
- Recommended fix
